item.title: [7.1] A Closer Look at Agentic BBO: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Black-Box Optimization
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Black-box optimization (BBO) arises in many scientific and engineering problems where objective evaluations are expensive and limited. Recent large language model (LLM) agents offer a new way to approach BBO by combining task semantics, computation, optimization tools, and feedback-driven decision making, showing great potential due to the integration with mathematically rigorous tools....

WHY IT MATTERS

This paper introduces a standardized cross-domain benchmark (AgenticBBO-Bench) for evaluating LLM agents in black-box optimization, addressing a key evaluation gap in the field.

item.title: [7.0] OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Recent 3D world models generate photorealistic, explorable scenes that remain frozen in time. OuroWorld is a mask-free framework that turns any static 3D Gaussian Splatting scene into a 3D cinemagraph: a dynamic scene with vivid, diverse motion looping seamlessly from any viewpoint. A vision-language model infers plausible dynamics and guides a video model to synthesize a reference video,...

WHY IT MATTERS

OuroWorld introduces a technically sound approach to animating static 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes with general motion and seamless looping, moving beyond rigid or fluid-only limitations.

item.title: [6.8] From Prompts to Trees: Effective LLM-Guided Tree Generation for Few-Shot Tabular Classification
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

While Large Language Models (LLMs) possess rich world knowledge and impressive generalization capabilities, their direct application to tabular data classification is hindered by high inference costs and limited interpretability. In contrast, decision trees are fast and transparent but often underperform in low-data regimes. In this work, we propose a novel framework that bridges these...

WHY IT MATTERS

This paper presents a practical, cost-effective framework for bridging LLMs and traditional decision trees for few-shot tabular classification, addressing a persistent limitation in enterprise AI applications.
